message: HOLD — 5 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: Permit clerks will not accept incomplete applications. Every field must be filled in or marked N/A. "Application must be filled out completely or it will not be accepted. If section is not applicable, enter N/A in space." — NPR Guide pg 58
critical_errors.check: Application filled out COMPLETELY — no blank fields (use N/A where not applicable)
critical_errors.notes: Three fields left blank on building permit application

critical_errors.description: Most permit offices require a notarized letter of authorization allowing the NPR to pull permits on the contractor's behalf. Some counties keep these on file; others need it each time. No authorization = cannot pull.
critical_errors.check: Notarized letter of authorization from contractor on file or attached
critical_errors.notes: No authorization letter from contractor — not on file at this permit office

critical_errors.description: Many permit forms MUST be notarized before submission: building permit applications, homeowner affidavits, notice of commencement, roofing applications, disclosure statements, and more. Un-notarized = rejected.
critical_errors.check: Forms requiring notarization are properly notarized BEFORE submission

critical_errors.description: Each county, city, and municipality has its own permit office. Submitting to the wrong jurisdiction = wasted trip. Verify which office has jurisdiction over the job site address.
critical_errors.check: Application submitted to the CORRECT permit office / jurisdiction
critical_errors.notes: Submitted to Oakland County but job site is in Wayne County

critical_errors.description: Verify the exact permit fee amount with the permit office before making the trip. Wrong amount = cannot pull the permit. "Always be certain that the amount of money you are collecting for the permits is the correct amount."
critical_errors.check: Correct payment amount for permit fees (verified before trip)
critical_errors.notes: Brought check for $85 but permit fee is $142
